description: Blocks for two parts of integration-profile.schema.json: claim blocks for the claim object, one valid and six invalid, and attribute source blocks for one entry of attribute_sources, one valid and five invalid. Validate each file against the subschema at the JSON Pointer in the case's schema_pointer, or in the top-level schema_pointer when the case has none, resolved inside spec/v1.0/profiles/integration-profile.schema.json, so that the schema's $defs apply. An invalid block must fail with exactly the listed errors: instance_pointer is the RFC 6901 location in the block, keyword the failing JSON Schema keyword.

cases.reason: both new fields present, every value in its enum, both arrays non-empty
conformance_profile names lite, which is not a conformance profile id in the registry
transport_profile names tcp, which is neither https nor stdio-ipc
conformance_profile and transport are both empty; each needs at least one entry
profile is not a claim key; the claim object is closed, and the bare word profile is never a JSON key
all four keys present, category environment, two approved native paths, freshness non-empty text
category names action, which is not a category: OperationContext.action carries the action
attributes is empty; a source answers at least one path
environment.network_zone is a dotted name, not an approved native path: a path starts with a slash and separates its segments with slashes
max_age_seconds is not an attribute source key; the object is closed, and the bounds belong to the freshness entry that freshness names
